Labels: the concept says 'Simulator' and 'Debrief'; ROUTINE_LABELS says 'Simulator session' and 'Event debrief' and is used in the generator, consents, history, settings 'Routines partners may request' and session titles. Order: the concept is Flight, Simulator, Training, Debrief; CREW_ROUTINES is simulator, flight, debrief, training, which also drives the settings and consent chip order. widget_map.full_view: A new /app/insights page (Past). It should list this week's insight first with Confirm, then earlier weeks: 'Week 40', 'Week 39', … each with title, body, focus label (Briefing preparation / Stress management / Debrief & reflection, the FOCUS labels from settings), and a 'Confirmed {date}' or 'Not confirmed' state from insight_acknowledgements.acknowledged_at. widget_map.gaps: (1) Snooze ('Hide it until next week'): no storage exists. (2) Past: there is no archive page. The catalog has no dates, only 6 rotating rows, so past weeks must be derived by computing weekIndex() for earlier dates; the acknowledgements table gives the user's confirmed history. (3) The rotation is hard-coded to modulo 6 in weekIndex(), so adding catalog rows does not extend it, and there is no admin UI to manage weekly_insights. (4) The concept headline 'Say the plan out loud before the checklist' and its body are not in the seed catalog (seed titles: 'Name the threat out loud', 'Two-breath reset', 'Debrief the decision, not the person', 'Assign the challenge word', 'Workload check-in', 'One lesson, one action'). (5) The desktop guide copy 'chosen for crews like yours' implies personalisation by user_preferences_and_consent.notification_focus, which selection ignores today. (6) The phone body copy is shorter than desktop, but the body is DB text, so phone must clamp lines (CSS line-clamp), not use different copy. (7) The confirmed state is not drawn on phone; with Confirm moved into the sheet, the card itself has no read indicator. (8) The '+10' reward is not shown anywhere on phone (the sheet label is just 'Confirm'). (9) Pin and Hide state are missing (see new capabilities).
widget_map.conflicts: Snoozing removes the only weekly prompt for the 'weekly_insight_read' award, which feeds current_streak_weeks (admin_award_credits updates the streak on any award). The Snooze copy should say the +10 for this week is forfeited unless the user un-snoozes. The ack key isoWeekKey() is computed in JS (UTC), while the award cooldown uses date_trunc('week', now()) in DB time. Both are Monday-based but can disagree around midnight; this is existing behaviour. Org admins must keep seeing aggregates only: no per-user insight reads leave the user (org_engagement_stats does not include them, and any addition must stay aggregate). Toasts: ToastProvider renders at fixed bottom-24 (96px) on phone, which would sit on top of the sheet (sheet spans about 104–220px from the bottom). Hide needs Undo, but ToastProvider actions only support {label, href} links, not callbacks.
widget_map.implementation_notes: Shape: fixed, left/right 20px, bottom calc(104px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); padding 12px 12px 10px; surface; hairline border; radius 12; shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(14,21,62,0.14). Header: 'Widget' (12px/800, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em) + ' · {title}', plus the 'Deselect' button. Make the button 44x44 hit area with a 32px visual. Use role='toolbar' aria-label='{title} tools' with roving tabindex and Left/Right arrows. Rendering rule: if widget tools + Pin + Hide <= 5, render them all; otherwise render primary + 3 widget tools + a 5th 'More tools' cell that opens a list with the rest (e.g. 'Last used' / 'Filter', 'Pin', 'Hide', 'Move up', 'Move down'). On select: set aria-pressed='true' on the header button, scroll the widget into view above the sheet, and announce '{title} selected' via an aria-live region. Move focus into the toolbar only for keyboard-initiated selection. Esc and 'Deselect' return focus to the header button. Do NOT use useOverlay (it locks body scroll); the canvas must stay scrollable. Deselect on route change (useCloseOnNavigate). Move the toast above the sheet while it is open (a CSS variable --toast-bottom set by the shell) and extend ToastProvider with an onAction callback for Undo.

new_capabilities: Per-user widget state (order, visibility, pin, snooze, desktop grid placement). New migration supabase/migrations/20261008000000_dashboard_canvas.sql: create table public.user_dashboard_widgets (user_id uuid not null references public.users(id) on delete cascade, widget_key text not null check (widget_key in ('start','insight','tier','recent','partners','report','rewards')), phone_order smallint check (phone_order between 0 and 50), grid_col smallint check (grid_col between 1 and 12), grid_row smallint check (grid_row between 1 and 200), size text check (size in ('S','M','L','XL')), pinned boolean not null default false, hidden boolean not null default false, snoozed_until timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz not null default now(), primary key (user_id, widget_key)); add a set_updated_at trigger. RLS: enable; policies select/insert/update/delete to authenticated using (user_id = (select auth.uid())) with check (user_id = (select auth.uid())). Grants: revoke all from anon, authenticated, then grant select, insert, update, delete to authenticated (the project's default-privileges lockdown requires explicit grants). Rows are created lazily by upsert; the app falls back to the registry defaults (phone order start, insight, tier, recent, then partners, report, rewards if enabled). Routes: server actions in src/app/app/actions.ts (or a new src/app/app/dashboard-actions.ts) setWidgetState({widget, pinned?, hidden?, snoozedUntil?}), moveWidget({widget, direction:'up'|'down'}), saveDesktopLayout(items[]) and resetDashboard(). Each runs assertRole('end_user','org_admin','super_admin'), Zod-validates widget keys and bounds, and calls revalidatePath('/app'). Extend scripts/rls-check.mjs with negative cases (another user's rows, anon) and regenerate database.types.ts with npm run db:types.

Dashboard settings and guide progress: create table public.user_dashboard_settings (user_id uuid primary key references public.users(id) on delete cascade, layout_locked boolean not null default false, layout_version int not null default 1, guide_version int not null default 0, guide_step smallint not null default 0 check (guide_step between 0 and 50), guide_completed_at timestamptz, guide_dismissed_at timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz not null default now()), owner-only RLS and grants as above. Server actions saveGuideProgress({step, completed, dismissed}) and setLayoutLocked(bool). Phone guide: reuse the desktop STEPS but retarget 'ctxbar' to the bottom sheet and 'mainbar' to the floating bar; the card is width calc(100vw − 40px), max-height 45vh, overflow auto, never covering the target or the bars. Auto-open on first visit when guide_completed_at and guide_dismissed_at are both null; reopen from More › 'Guide'.

Widget registry and selection model (code only): src/lib/dashboard/widgets.ts declares each widget key with title, aria title, allowed roles (partners only for end_user; Coaching link only for org_admin/super_admin), phone default order, desktop default span, the tools list (label, icon, primary, kind: link/action/sheet, href builder) and the full-view route. A client CrewCanvas component holds `selected: WidgetKey | null` and renders a ContextSheet. The sheet's 5-cell overflow rule applies: primary + up to 3 widget tools + 'More tools' when the total exceeds 5. Escape deselects, as does route change. No persistence for the selection itself.

Insight snooze and archive: snooze is stored as user_dashboard_widgets.snoozed_until for widget_key 'insight', set to the next ISO Monday 00:00 UTC (no extra table). New page src/app/app/insights/page.tsx (Past), backed by a server-side helper listPastInsights(n) that computes weekIndex() for each of the last n ISO weeks, joins public.weekly_insights by week_index and the user's public.insight_acknowledgements by iso_week, all via existing RLS (insights_select true, acks_select own). Optional catalog management: make weekIndex modulo = count(*) of weekly_insights, and add a super-admin page /super/insights with insert/update through a service-role action (no new crew grants).

Full credit ledger: /app/rewards?tab=log (or src/app/app/rewards/activity/page.tsx) with range-based pagination over public.gamification_logs (RLS logs_select own, index gamification_logs_user_action_idx) and an action filter. Add anchors #catalog, #rules and #log on src/app/app/rewards/page.tsx for the sheet tools. Add effectiveStreak(status, now) in src/lib/gamification-shared.ts so a stale current_streak_weeks shows 0 once last_action_at is older than the previous ISO week.

History filters and pagination: src/app/app/routines/history/page.tsx (or #history on /app/routines) with query params kind=solo|synergy, routine=flight|simulator|training|debrief, page=N. Queries public.routine_sessions under the existing sessions_select RLS; partner_user_id is null for Solo and not null for Synergy, excluding routine_code 'coaching'. Helpers in src/lib/utils.ts: formatRelativeDay(), sessionTitle(routine_code) (shared with the [id] page) and shortName(full_name) ('Yoav Peretz' → 'Yoav P.'), each with unit tests in tests/unit/utils.test.ts.

'Last used' / prefill from a session: /app/routines?from={sessionId}. The server page loads that session (RLS-scoped to primary_user_id) and passes initialRoutine, initialPartner (only if the consent is still valid, per loadConsentedPartners) and initialContext {aircraft, phase, scenario, notes} to RoutineGenerator, which gains defaultValue props. Add an id='context' anchor on the context fields.

On-demand 'Copy cards': server action getSessionCardsText(sessionId) selects ai_generated_output for the caller's own session (RLS) and returns outputToText(...). The client writes it with navigator.clipboard.writeText. Clipboard needs a secure context and is not restricted by the current Permissions-Policy.

Consent revoke (for the Sharing full view and the desktop Partners widget): migration to extend consent_requests.status check with 'revoked'; change private.consent_guard to allow old.status = 'approved' → 'revoked' (stamping responded_at and setting valid_until = now() inside the trigger); add RLS policy consent_revoke_target for update to authenticated using (target_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and status = 'approved') with check (target_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and status = 'revoked'). runCrewRoutine and loadConsentedPartners already filter status = 'approved', so revoked rows stop working immediately. Server action revokeConsent with audit 'consent.revoked'. A per-request duration ('a number of days') would need a requested_days column bounded e.g. 1–30 and the guard to use it; this is a product decision.

Slim wall metadata RPC: public.admin_wall_get_link_meta(p_user_id uuid) returns table(framework text, linked_at timestamptz, method text), SECURITY DEFINER, set search_path = '', revoke from public, grant execute to service_role only, mirroring the existing admin_wall_* lockdown block. This lets any report status line show 'MBTI Step II · linked by your admin · {date}' without loading the persona.

Search (More › 'Search'): server page src/app/app/search/page.tsx?q= (GET, no new API). It covers static destinations (Start routine, History, Sharing, Rewards, My report, Notifications & privacy), the user's own routine_sessions matched on routine_code and scenario_context->>'aircraft'/'phase'/'scenario' via ilike, own reflections, active organization_rewards titles and weekly_insights titles, all through the user's RLS client. Optional index: create extension pg_trgm and gin indexes on (scenario_context->>'scenario') and (scenario_context->>'aircraft'). Never search crew_directory beyond the existing pickers, and never touch the wall.

risks: Touch drag and reorder: the 6-dot drag handle is a mouse affordance. On phone it should not be draggable (it would fight vertical scroll). WCAG 2.5.7 Dragging Movements requires a single-pointer alternative, so provide 'Move up' / 'Move down' in the sheet overflow and an 'Add widget' list. Treat the handle as a decorative aria-hidden glyph, or remove it on phone to avoid a false affordance.

Keyboard and screen readers: the concept's sheet is a bare div with no role, its tool buttons have no aria-labels, 'Confirm' is ambiguous, no Escape handler exists, focus management is undefined, and the header aria-label 'Select widget: Weekly insight' does not include the visible 'Insight · Week 41' (WCAG 2.5.3). Needed: role='toolbar' with roving tabindex, aria-pressed on headers, an aria-live announcement on select, Esc to deselect with focus returned, and a DOM order that keeps the sheet after the selected widget or reachable with a skip link.

Touch targets and legibility: 'Deselect' is 32x32 (the app uses 44px minimums; WCAG 2.5.8 AA passes at 24px, but the house standard does not). Tool and main-bar labels are 10px/700, smaller than today's 11px, which matters for pilots reading in dim cockpits or crew rooms. Check contrast of the muted text oklch(0.5 0.035 275) on the tinted Insight card oklch(0.93 0.03 275), which is borderline around 4.5:1.

Colour semantics: using #BD2025 red for primary actions (Start, Confirm, Continue) collides with the existing red danger/error tone (--bad: 'Decline', 'Sign out', error alerts). The red badge dot is colour-only. Give Sharing a text alternative and keep red action and danger visually distinct, e.g. destructive actions as outline red text, primary as filled red.

Dark mode: the app ships a dark theme (data-theme cookie), but the concept defines no dark tokens. #0E153E ink, rings and the logo 'S' would vanish on the dark background. A full dark token set must be designed before shipping, or the canvas will regress for current dark-mode users.

Phone viewport budget: with the sheet open, the floating bars cover about 220px plus the safe area of an 844px screen (26%). On a 667px iPhone SE about 40% is covered. Every widget needs a scroll-into-view-above-the-sheet on select, and the canvas needs a dynamic bottom inset or the last widget stays hidden, as it does in the mockup. Landscape phones may need the sheet to collapse to an icon row. The viewport uses viewportFit 'cover', so both top and bottom env(safe-area-inset-*) must be applied.

Two-tap actions: moving Insight 'Confirm' and Start 'Continue' into the selection sheet adds a tap and hides the credit reward (+10) from phone users. That may lower weekly-insight confirmations and therefore streaks. Consider keeping a visible inline confirmed/confirm state on the card.

Overlay stacking: the context sheet (non-modal), the More sheet (modal with scrim), the AccountMenu, toasts (fixed bottom-24) and the guide card can overlap. Define z-order and mutual exclusion: opening More or the account menu deselects, and toasts lift above the sheet.

Shared-component blast radius: changing ChipRadio's selected style, ProgressBar defaults, Pill radius, icon paths or the global tokens (hue 240/250 → 275) also changes the generator, consents, settings, /admin and /super consoles. Use variants or scoped tokens, or plan a coordinated restyle.

Performance: the overview already issues 7 queries plus the layout's 2 (the pending-consent count is duplicated). Adding widget prefs, scenario_context, gamification_rules, org name and partners adds round trips; keep them in one Promise.all with narrow selects. Never load ai_generated_output (large jsonb) or the full wall persona on the dashboard: use on-demand actions and the slim admin_wall_get_link_meta. The canvas becomes a client component, so keep it light and do not ship a drag-and-drop library to phones.

CSP (next.config.ts: script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline', style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline', img-src 'self' data: blob:, font-src 'self' data:, connect-src 'self' + Supabase). The dot grid (CSS gradient) and inline styles are fine, and an inline or /public SVG logo is fine. Do NOT copy the concept's Google-hosted Manrope @font-face (font-src would block it); keep next/font self-hosting, which also loads weight 400 that the concept omits. Any DnD or guide library must be bundled from npm, not loaded from a CDN. Clipboard 'Copy cards' requires HTTPS (the local http prod server on :4000 is a secure context only on localhost).

Product-rule regressions: a 'Coaching' chip for crew would hit a 400 from GenerateInsightRequestSchema and blur the manager-only coaching tool. Partner role subtitles would leak operational_category, against crew_directory's minimisation. Tier names 'Ready/Proficient' imply ranking and clash with the bronze/silver/gold/platinum check constraint and org-admin aggregates. Showing '14 days' as a fixed validity misstates the 30-day approval window. Revoke and per-request duration need schema and trigger changes, not just UI.

Data correctness already visible in the widgets: current_streak_weeks is stale for idle users. Coaching sessions show as 'Blind synergy' in an org admin's Recent list. Progress uses earned/next.min_credits while tierProgress().percent uses the floor-relative span, so the two views can disagree. Fix these before the widgets amplify them.

Layout persistence edge cases: role changes (end_user ↔ org_admin) can leave saved prefs for widgets the new role may not see, so filter by registry roles at render time. New widgets added in future releases need a migration path (layout_version). Hidden-everything states need an empty-canvas message pointing to More › 'Add widget'. Prefs must never be readable by org admins except through aggregate functions.

Responsive conflict: the desktop board's ≤720px rules (context bar as a top strip) contradict the phone board (bottom sheet). The repo breakpoint is md = 720px. Pick the phone board for < 720px and document it, or tablets in the 390–720px range get an undesigned hybrid.
